observations.baud_caveat: Frozen unit/gps.py hard-codes 9600; the product page says 115200. The guest cannot expose the configured baud, so the 9600 host fixture is recorded and the page value stays UNRESOLVED/NOT validated.

raw_evidence_note: Raw execution artifacts (evidence.zip, frame.png, serial.txt, probe files) stay in the local ignored .work directory; only concise reports, hashes and reproduction commands are committed.
blocker: Guest GPSUnit on cores3 (shared AT6668 NMEA path) decoded the injected NMEA fixture exactly (lat/lon/time/date/satellites/altitude/course/speed) and QOM injected-lines observed. The 9600-driver vs 115200-page baud conflict remains UNRESOLVED and the external active SMA antenna/RF/accuracy are NOT RUN; results are not transferred between GPS v1.1 and GPS SMA.
